subject: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-inc.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 19 Feb 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers

Team / Tim,

Ahead of our Wednesday leadership slot, I put together a short pack that summarizes engineering delivery windows, a condensed risk heatmap, and the contingency triggers we plan to use if any rollout signals breach thresholds. High level:

- Target GA: 2028-04-15 for the embeddings routing and cost-tuning changes.
- Canary window: 2028-04-01 — 2028-04-07 (low traffic) with progressive traffic ramp.
- Primary risks: model QoR regressions on long-context prompts, autoscaler lag under sustained 99th percentile load, and a dependency on the new KV-cache library (internal infra).

Attachments: Q2_release_timeline.xlsx (sheets: milestones, owners, gating criteria), risk_heatmap_v2.png (heatmap with mitigations).

Asks for this thread:
1) Karthik — confirm the autoscaler SLA burn tests and whether we need an extra buffer week.
2) Ava — can you validate the KV-cache canary plan and fallback isolation?
3) Tim / ACME — any constraints on your side for the canary dates?

I will consolidate answers and publish a one-page decision memo for the leadership meeting.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP Product
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers

Neha — quick read, thanks. A few specifics from infra/tests:

- Autoscaler SLA burn tests: scheduled week of 2028-03-18. Current estimate shows 18–24 hours of steady-state failure to breach the target; that suggests we want the extra buffer week you mentioned. Recommend moving GA to 2028-04-22 unless we pre-run a synthetic stress test in week of 2028-03-11.
- We do have a soft dependency on the KV-cache library, but we can gate its rollout to a single region and still hit the core feature set for GA.

Open question: do we want to include a manual rollback trigger when 95th percentile latency increases by >30% over baseline for two consecutive 10-minute windows? If yes, we should codify the alert and the on-call play.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-inc.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers

Thanks — read and added a few notes in the timeline spreadsheet (owner column).

On the KV-cache canary: plan is to do region-limited canary in us-west-2 with traffic shaping (start at 1% then 10% then 25%). If QoR regressions appear for long-context customers we will automatically divert those sessions to the legacy pipeline (no model change) and mark the canary as paused. Fallback steps are captured in the attached snippet in the drive (see related link).

On rollback triggers: agree with Karthik. Recommend we add an automated rollback for sustained 95th percentile +30% for 20 minutes, and a manual leadership rollback for sustained P99 > 200ms over baseline for 10 minutes. I flagged the alerting play to Monica for runbook updates.

-Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-inc.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers

Neha / team — this looks reasonable. Two asks from ACME side:

1) Can we get a snapshot of expected cost delta for the GA config vs current baseline for our forecasting? If you can put a short table in the decision memo that would be great.
2) For the canary week, can you confirm whether our traffic will be included in the 1% pool? If ACME is excluded from first two steps we might not uncover long-context regressions that matter to us.

If you need us to be in the early 1% bucket, we can sign an agreement to accept elevated monitoring and a joint rollback SLA.

Thanks — Tim
Tim Jenkins
Head of Platform Engineering
ACME Inc.
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@acme-inc.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 16:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 leadership brief — release cadence, risk heatmap & contingency triggers

Thanks all — summary and decisions (for the leadership slot):

- GA tentative date moved to 2028-04-22 to allow autoscaler burn tests/synthetic stress on 2028-03-11 and 03-18.
- Canary window remains 2028-04-01 to 2028-04-07 but we will include ACME in the 1% pool by agreement; Tim, please confirm and sign the joint rollback SLA (Monica/Legal will send a short form).
- Rollback/alerting triggers: automated rollback for sustained P95 +30% for 20 minutes; leadership manual rollback for sustained P99 > +200ms for 10 minutes. Monica will own the runbook update.
- KV-cache will be region-gated to us-west-2 for canary; fallback path to legacy pipeline is validated.
- Action: Karthik to schedule the synthetic stress pre-run (2028-03-11). Ava to publish canary playbook and owners. Monica to coordinate legal/comms for ACME early inclusion and finalize the one-page decision memo.

I'll publish the decision memo and slide one-pager by EOD Thursday. If there are major objections, flag now.

Regards,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP Product
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Q2_release_timeline.xlsx, risk_heatmap_v2.png
